{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Clean: keep only the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_cleaned = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the distribution of `arm` and `severity` to see if they are confounded
print("Distribution of arm:")
print(df_cleaned['arm'].value_counts())
print("\nDistribution of severity:")
print(df_cleaned['severity'].value_counts())

# Cross-tabulate arm vs severity to check confounding
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_cleaned['arm'], df_cleaned['severity']))"}
